summary.headline: Dedication to Philipp Melanchthon
summary.text: Joachim Heller dedicates the first public edition of an Arabic astrologer’s work to Philipp Melanchthon, describing an ancient archetype of commentaries on celestial matters from Matthias, king of Hungary’s library, along with other books by ancient astrologers.
